definitions.gloss: everywhere; every single place; all over
definitions.explanation: An emphatic form of どこも (every place): どこも + かしこ (there, an old word for あそこ) + も. Usually describes a place that is full of something or the same everywhere, often with a hint of complaint or surprise.

examples.japanese: どこもかしこも⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦だらけ→〜だらけ：18372_darake⟧だ。
⟦{連休|れんきゅう}→連休：07587_renkyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どこもかしこも⟦{混|こ}んでいた→混む：02574_komu⟧。
examples.english: Everywhere was crowded during the long weekend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大掃除|おおそうじ}→大掃除：08347_oosouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どこもかしこもほこり⟦だらけ→〜だらけ：18372_darake⟧だった。
examples.english: I meant to do a big clean, but the house was covered in dust all over.

notes:
Used mostly in speech and casual writing. Often with 〜⟦だらけ→〜だらけ：18372_darake⟧ (full of) or a negative judgment.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- どこもかしこも⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦だらけ→〜だらけ：18372_darake⟧: people everywhere
- どこもかしこも⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧だ: it is the same everywhere
- どこもかしこも⟦{満席|まんせき}→満席：07585_manseki⟧: every place is full

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どこも→どこも：32843_dokomo⟧: every place; plain, and with a negative means "nowhere"
- ⟦{至|いた}る{所|ところ}→至る所：15861_itarutokoro⟧: everywhere; more written
